### Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases (30 Test Cases)

- **`test-token-errors.js`** (6 tests): Missing authorization header (401), invalid prefix `ps_test_` (401), empty org identifier `ps_live_` (401), random non-PortalSync bearer token (401), cross-tenant update attempt (403), empty string bearer token (401).
- **`test-status-transitions.js`** (6 tests): Backward `completed` -> `running` (409), backward `failed` -> `pending` (409), skip `pending` -> `completed` without running (409), double claim race condition (409), unknown status string `exploded` (409), cancelled run to `running` (409).
- **`test-empty-bodies.js`** (6 tests): Empty body on POST `/runs` (400), malformed non-JSON on POST `/artifacts` (400), missing `run_id` on POST `/artifacts` (400), missing `sha256_hash` on POST `/artifacts` (400), whitespace-only workflow name on POST `/workflows` (400), non-existent `run_id` on PATCH `/runs` (404).
- **`test-file-hash-uniqueness.js`** (6 tests): Canonical NIST zero-byte hash verification (`e3b0c442...`), duplicate identical byte stream deduplication, single-byte avalanche effect, filename collision hash-suffix auto-resolution, multi-file batch deduplication sequence, non-existent source file error.
- **`test-timeout-90s-edge.js`** (6 tests): Exact 90s boundary expiration trip, wire-edge resolution right before timeout, negative elapsed / clock skew clamping to 0, concurrent independent run timers, immediate resolution (0.1s) loop bypass, `onTick` callback non-negative integer emission.

## 5. Implementation Bug Discovered (Escalation to Implementing Agent)

During forensic inspection of `packages/engine/src/runner/runner.test.js` and `packages/engine/src/runner/runner-daemon.js`:
- **File**: `packages/engine/src/runner/runner-daemon.js`
- **Issue**: `RunnerDaemon` class is missing the `handleHitlIntervention(runId, page, challengeInfo)` method called by `packages/engine/src/runner/runner.test.js` at line 524 (`await daemon.handleHitlIntervention(...)`).
- **Impact**: Running `node packages/engine/src/runner/runner.test.js` fails on test 20 (`Adversarial - handleHitlIntervention updates cloud to requires_action and fails on 90s timeout`).
- **Remediation**: `worker_m3` (Desktop Runner implementer) should wire `handleHitlIntervention` onto `RunnerDaemon` using `hitl-detector.js`'s `waitFor2FAResolution` and `cloudClient.updateRunStatus`.
